title: ExecutionTask
description: Canonical ExecutionTask (ARCHITECTURE.md §33 shared-state list; id family T-#.# per §33 example 'T-4.2 implements D-17'). Distinct from WorkerCapsule (legion-worker-capsule-v1): ExecutionTask is Sage/Execution-Compile-owned durable state inside an ExecutionContract; WorkerCapsule is the mechanical, zero-context projection dispatched to an executor (ARCHITECTURE §31).

kernelTaskId.description: Cross-reference to the Kernel's durable lifecycle task handle, when one has been started for this ExecutionTask. See ids.md open question: ARCHITECTURE/IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN never explicitly unify or distinguish 'ExecutionTask' from the Kernel's 'task' object; this field is the seam. FREEZE.md open question.

ownScope.description: ARCHITECTURE §32a: disjoint own[] scope is the parallelism-partitioning tool.

exact.description: artifactUnit ids from the owning ExecutionContract.

status.description: Reuses ALCHEMIST_STATE verbatim per ARCHITECTURE §18's explicit instruction that these become 'part of Legion's shared state vocabulary, not duplicated ad hoc'. A task not yet started/in progress is represented by the absence of a terminal/intermediate state marker upstream (Kernel INVOCATION_STATE), not by an eighth value here — see FREEZE.md judgment call J-6.

routingDecision.description: ARCHITECTURE §6a cost-based execution routing: 'The orchestrator logs model, tier, predicted cost, and the reason.'
